thread:
sam.choi: Heads up — we had an ops rollout succeed for canary but it appears safelist policy allowed rollout without canary perm check. Repro: triggered A/B rollout at 18:12 UTC, canary gate didn't block.
maya: Can you paste the policy that was applied? I think the recent rbac refactor added `allow_rollout_safelist` flag.
sam.choi: pasted snippet:
```
roles:
  - name: rollout_operator
    permissions:
      - rollout:canary:execute
      - rollout:canary:override_safelist # <-- suspect
``` 
jonah: That `override_safelist` was added in PR #3214 to support emergency ops. It should have been gated behind feature flag `ops.override_rollout_safelist`.
leo: deploy-bot shows the deploy: `deploy-bot: deploy/rollout-service v2.3.0 started by sam.choi (canary)`
deploy-bot: @channel deploy/rollout-service v2.3.0 SUCCESS in 45s
security-bot: Alert: audit-log shows principal `svc/ops-runner` instead of `user/sam.choi` for the canary execute call — looks like service account escalation.
maya: Query I ran: `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE resource='rollout' AND action='canary.execute' AND ts> '2026-03-19' LIMIT 50;` returned multiple `svc/ops-runner` entries.
ops-sre: Temporary mitigation: revoked `ops-runner` safelist with `rctl safelist remove ops-runner rollout` — will that break other flows?
jonah: It might; `ops-runner` is used by scheduled emergency rollbacks. Suggest adding a scoped role `emergency_rollout` instead of blanket override.
sam.choi: Proposal: revert PR #3214, create scoped flag, wire feature-flag check in authz layer. Also add a compliance audit entry for any `override_safelist` usage.
leo: Also add KMS key usage check — we saw `kms:decrypt` logs from same timeframe. Maybe service account gained broader perms via KMS grant.
maya: Filing issue: https://internal.redwood/issue/INF-9812 — triage, assign to eng-security and eng-platform.
jonah: I'll draft the PR for rolling back and adding an explicit `allow_emergency_rollout` role with time-bound TTL + audit hook.
ops-sre: +1, coordinate with oncall. @eng-oncall please watch for rollback side effects.
sam.choi: Thanks. I'll collect logs and escalate to compliance if needed. :eyes:
